name: Stormwatch Lighthouse
description: A weathered, colourful lighthouse on a rocky outcrop, rising over the city. Now with animated beacon light, sea spray and tidal glints and visitor-reactive glow. Tall wind-swaying coastal grass, a walking hooded keeper and flowing water with downloaded wave-normal textures enrich the exterior.

credits.work: Original lighthouse model and painted texture
Surface reconstruction, texture transfer and distance meshes
Lighthouse, keeper and leviathan concept references
Original vector key poses, weapon effects and procedural sound
Animated keeper beacons and themed exterior visual effects
